body: Air Canada will pull the Boeing 787 from 11 routes in the coming months: Calgary–London, Ottawa–London, Montreal–Toulouse, Montreal–Porto, Montreal–Copenhagen, Montreal–Paris, Montreal–Edinburgh, Montreal–Casablanca, Montreal–Berlin, Toronto–Zurich and Toronto–Venice. Six of those services will see the Airbus A321XLR on some or all frequencies, while some routes will instead see the Boeing 777 or Airbus A330. The changes coincide with the airline's planned expansion for the 2026/2027 winter season and the 2027 summer season, and the XLRs were also ordered to further optimize its transatlantic network.

The A321XLR carries just 182 seats, with 14 business class seats and no premium economy cabin, against 255 seats and 20 business class seats on the 787-8 and 298 seats and 30 business class seats on the 787-9, both of which also have a 21-seat premium economy cabin. The 787 was previously the long-range aircraft with the lowest operating costs in Air Canada's fleet, but that is now the A321XLR. Air Canada now operates five A321XLRs, with 25 more on the way; the first was delivered in April 2026, and the airline has ordered 30 in total. The freed-up 787s will move to routes where their size, range and fuel efficiency are valuable: Toronto–Barcelona from December, alongside new Vancouver–Sapporo services, with Vancouver–Guangzhou and Montreal–Dubrovnik launching in May 2027, the 787 on Montreal–Tel Aviv and Toronto–Prague, and Toronto–Stockholm from June. Apart from Barcelona, all of these routes are too long for the A321XLR to operate.

Air Canada's widebody fleet currently stands at 20 Airbus A330-300s, six Boeing 777-200LRs, 19 Boeing 777-300ERs, eight 787-8s and 32 787-9s, making the 40-strong Dreamliner fleet its largest. The 787-10, the first of which is already being tested by Boeing, is set to start arriving later in 2026; the carrier has 14 on firm order with 12 options, to be delivered until 2030, and with 332 seats it will have a higher capacity than any other widebody except the 777-300ER. Air Canada also holds eight orders for the Airbus A350-1000, with options for eight more, set to start arriving in 2030. Separately, the airline will discontinue its nonstop Vancouver–Singapore route in January 2027, its longest route, with current fuel prices among the factors behind the cut; oil prices are nearly $90 per barrel, according to the source.
en.summary: Air Canada will pull the Boeing 787 from 11 routes in the coming months, with six of them moving to the Airbus A321XLR on some or all frequencies. The 182-seat XLR, with no premium economy cabin, costs less to run and suits weaker Europe routes, while the freed-up 787s move to longer services including new Vancouver–Guangzhou and Montreal–Dubrovnik flights launching in May 2027.
en.title: Air Canada replaces Boeing 787s with Airbus A321XLRs on some routes, redeploying Dreamliners to new long-haul destinations

body: 加拿大航空表示，787將在未來數月撤出11條航線，包括卡加利—倫敦、渥太華—倫敦、蒙特婁—土魯斯、蒙特婁—波爾圖、蒙特婁—哥本哈根、蒙特婁—巴黎、蒙特婁—愛丁堡、蒙特婁—卡薩布蘭卡、蒙特婁—柏林、多倫多—蘇黎世與多倫多—威尼斯；其中6條航線將由A321XLR執飛部分或全部班次，部分航線則改由777或A330執飛。這波調整配合2026/2027年冬季班表與2027年夏季班表的擴張，A321XLR也將用於新航線的開拓。

A321XLR僅182座、商務艙14座且無豪華經濟艙，相較787-8的255座、20座商務艙與787-9的298座、30座商務艙明顯較小，兩款787另設有21座豪華經濟艙。加航指出，787原本是機隊中營運成本最低的長程機，如今由A321XLR取代；加航現有5架A321XLR，另有25架待交付，首架於2026年4月交付，總訂單30架。騰出的787將轉往更有價值的長程航線：12月起飛多倫多—巴塞隆納，並新開溫哥華—札幌；2027年5月新開溫哥華—廣州、蒙特婁—杜布羅夫尼克，787也將執飛蒙特婁—特拉維夫與多倫多—布拉格，6月起飛多倫多—斯德哥爾摩；除巴塞隆納外，這些航線都超出A321XLR的航程。

加航寬體機隊現有20架A330-300、6架777-200LR、19架777-300ER、8架787-8與32架787-9，787機隊共40架；787-10將於2026年稍晚開始交付，堅定訂單14架、另有12架選擇權，2030年前交付完畢，332座的787-10將是除777-300ER外機隊中載客量最大的寬體機。加航另訂有8架A350-1000、另有8架選擇權，預計2030年起交付。另一方面，加航將於2027年1月停飛溫哥華—新加坡直飛航線，這是加航最長的航線；燃油價格是停飛的因素之一，當前油價接近每桶90美元。
zh.summary: 加拿大航空將在未來數月把787撤出11條航線，其中6條改由A321XLR執飛部分或全部班次；A321XLR僅182座、無豪華經濟艙，營運成本更低，適合載客較弱的歐洲航線，騰出的787則轉往多倫多—巴塞隆納等長程航線與2027年5月新開的溫哥華—廣州、蒙特婁—杜布羅夫尼克等航點。
zh.title: 加航以A321XLR取代部分787航班：11條航線調整、騰出的787轉飛長程新航點
